title: Build empty local Staging role databases from exact schema bundles

phases.objective: Refuse all mixed, partial and populated role databases before local DDL, then import exact three-role schema bundles and complete canonical seed, grants and runtime readback.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Rebuild-EmptyStagingRoleDatabases.ps1 with exact commit and explicit confirmations
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Three empty role schemas can be rebuilt from the exact bundle; a non-empty role blocks all DDL; provider apply certification remains pending.
steps: Inspect local root object counts for all three roles before any DDL.
Reject partial, mixed, wrong-role and malformed census evidence.
Build and validate canonical role bundles on the exact clean checkout.
Repeat root census inside the import lock; apply schema, seeds, readback then grants.
Require independent certification for any later provider apply.
assertions: A non-empty role or unknown object forbids rebuild_empty for all roles.
Schema import failure prevents governance seed and grant phase.
The Gateway governance certification seed is pending with dispatch/apply disabled.
No Production, provider or destructive reset mutation is performed by this test.
